method.filtering_summary: Live search at about 7:35 AM EAT on 16 sources (15 answered; ReliefWeb failed again) pulled 2,729 postings. 1,893 were older than 7 days and 96 were old reposts, 275 senior or excluded titles, 141 not target roles, 182 excluded Kenya and 56 duplicates, leaving 86. 30 of those had already been shown in earlier briefings (including micro1's Electron.js Software Engineer and AI Agent Tester), so they were skipped. Jobgether answered live (501 offers, 215 from the last 7 days, 31 kept), but every new engineering offer opened was limited to one European country, the UK, South Africa or U.S. residents, or asked 4+ years, so none made the list. micro1 had one new role (an imagery analyst contract for U.S.-based people), set aside. Wellfound (170 pulled, 3 kept) blocks automated page checks, so its three roles are shown from today's live listing data only. TensorOps and Vetto were confirmed on their own Greenhouse boards; an on-site Nairobi LLM role is listed under set aside.

stories.title: Grok Bot 0.78 adds shopping cards, Shop Pay and subscription templates
stories.summary: Version 0.78.1 shows shopping results as product cards, adds a Buy now order you approve, Shop Pay in the Vault's Payments tab, and templates for free trials and unused subscriptions.
stories.why: xAI is pushing Grok Bot from answering into acting (buying, cancelling) with approval steps, the same agent-with-guardrails pattern he builds.

stories.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a cybersecurity-focused frontier model
stories.summary: Google says Carbon ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 at 59 and scores 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro; it starts with trusted cyber defenders in the Fairwind Program.
stories.why: Coding and secure-code gains at the frontier set the bar for the AI coding tools he uses every day.

stories.title: Mistral releases open weights for Large 4 (Le Chonk)
stories.summary: The 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model is now open weight under a modified MIT license, priced at $0.70 input and $2.10 output per million tokens via the API.
stories.why: A large open-weight model he can self-host with vLLM or SGLang, relevant to his quantization and self-hosting experience.

stories.title: OPay prices its NYSE IPO at $19, raising $304 million
stories.summary: Nigeria's OPay sold 16 million ADSs at the low end of its $19–$21 range, giving it a market cap of about $4.0 billion; trading is expected to start on Oct. 30.
stories.why: The biggest African fintech listing in years, a test of how U.S. investors value African payments businesses like the ones he has worked in.

stories.title: Binance says $6.3bn in crypto was hit by a hack
stories.summary: Binance says about $6.3bn of assets were impacted and about half frozen; early checks point to a compromised engineer's laptop, and TRM Labs attributes it to North Korea's TraderTraitor unit.
stories.why: Described as the largest hack in history, and it started with one engineer's machine, a reminder about access controls in fintech systems.

stories.title: Wabi raises $55M at a $1.25B valuation for its personal AI agent
stories.summary: Replika founder Eugenia Kuyda's Wabi, which builds mini apps as a personal agent, raised $55 million in a round led by IVP.
stories.why: More money flowing into consumer agent apps, the kind of startups hiring agent and full-stack engineers.

stories.title: Agent identity startup Mintive raises a $7M seed
stories.summary: Mintive has raised $11 million total; its platform includes an MCP gateway, an LLM gateway and agent identity management, with more than 50 enterprise customers.
stories.why: MCP gateways and agent governance are becoming their own product category, close to his MCP and automation skills.

stories.title: Banks and healthcare firms are outbidding tech for software engineers
stories.summary: Randstad research finds healthcare pays up to 17% more and banks 13% more than tech for software engineers; job postings requiring AI capabilities grew fivefold in a year.
stories.why: Non-tech employers, especially banks, are hiring AI-capable engineers, which suits his fintech background.

stories.title: Grey launches Paycheck, a salary account for people paid in dollars, pounds and euros
stories.summary: The YC-backed cross-border payments company, which has processed nearly $5 billion, announced Paycheck at Moonshot in Lagos.
stories.why: Relevant if he lands a remote role paid in foreign currency.

stories.title: Safaricom dismissed 118 staff for fraud even as incidents fell 82%
stories.summary: Its 2026 Sustainable Business Report lists 118 dismissals in the year to March, up from 113, and more than four times the 28 in the year to March 2021.
stories.why: Insider fraud and automated controls around M-PESA are a live engineering problem at Kenya's biggest fintech.

stories.title: Fuliza Ya Pochi reaches over one million M-PESA merchants
stories.summary: Safaricom says the credit facility, launched on October 22, now extends working credit to more than one million eligible Pochi La Biashara merchants.
stories.why: Merchant credit built on transaction data, the same idea as the SACCO loan pipeline he built at Kwara.

stories.title: NCBA's LOOP launches LOOP BIZ+ for SME payments, stock and loans
stories.summary: LOOP BIZ+ combines a POS, an AI inventory tool and credit based on POS transaction history; LOOP Discover reaches more than 500,000 users.
stories.why: Kenyan banks are bundling AI tools and lending for small merchants, a growing area for fintech engineering jobs.
